about: Change Replay (js/replay.js): which layers each case terrain loops through and which rule outlines the changed blocks. Pass DATES are not written here: they come from the case's numbers file (the verdict's own passes = its NASA files minus quality_control.excluded_passes) and the grid's dated layers of 'unit'. Thresholds come from the numbers file's method block ('method:' keys). Captions are templates: {m:<measured label>} = that measured value + unit, {method:<key>} = a method number, {badge}, {badge_reason}, {first}/{last}/{date} = the replayed pass dates ('15 Sep'). A missing value makes the whole caption disappear, never a made-up number. CHANGE phase: blocks past the rule FLASH, red = the radar value fell (burned, lost, sank), cyan = it rose (new structures, new water); 'colour' = red / cyan for the whole case or 'sign' per block; 'legend' = the line that says so ({threshold} = this file's own display threshold).

change.legend: Flashing red = burned (radar fell ≥ {method:burn_db|abs} dB; blocks at least half burned)

big-sur.caption: HV fell ≥ {method:burn_db|abs} dB on {m:Burned (NISAR HV fell ≥ 2 dB)}: burned forest

change.legend: Flashing cyan = new structures (radar rose ≥ {method:X_db} dB, background removed)

jebel-ali.caption: HH rose ≥ {method:X_db} dB on {m:New structures (HH rose ≥ 3 dB)}: new structures, by the radar rule (photo check pending)

change.legend: Flashing red = Trap 8: one bad date (raw HH jumped ≥ {method:X_db} dB), not construction
Flashing cyan = became water (≥ {threshold}% of the block) · red = dried out

tonle-sap.caption: Open water {m:Open water {first}} → {m:Open water {last}} · flooded forest {last}: {m:Flooded forest {last} (L-band only)}

change.legend: Flashing red = sank ≥ {method:sinking_mm|abs} mm by {last} (relative to central Jakarta)
Flashing red = HV fell ≥ {method:crop_present_db} dB (crop echo lost) · cyan = rose ≥ {method:crop_present_db} dB

al-ain.caption: Pivots on {last}: A {m:Pivot A} · B {m:Pivot B} · C {m:Pivot C} · D {m:Pivot D} (crop present at ≥ +{method:crop_present_db} dB over the desert)
